about: Cheat tables, in the JSON form the cheat runners on this platform read.
PROVENANCE. Read from TeeKay87/HEN-Cheats-Collection, which holds 790 PS5 tables among
5000 in total. Each entry below was downloaded and hashed here rather than taken on
THE URLS ARE PINNED TO A COMMIT, NOT TO A BRANCH. A branch url serves whatever is there
today, so its digest goes stale the moment anybody pushes - and a stale digest reads as
a corrupted download, which sends somebody hunting a network fault that does not exist.
Pinned at c78f5ea6c136, these files cannot change under the digests below.
The filename carries the title id, the game version the table was written for, and a
hash: PPSA01460_01.015.001_4eed96b4.json. A TABLE FOR ONE GAME VERSION DOES NOT APPLY TO
ANOTHER - the addresses move, and applying the wrong one writes to whatever is there now.
Four entries is a demonstration, not a library. The collection is browsable at the source
url, and anything in it can be added here by pasting its raw url and its digest.
The format is docs/manifest.schema.json - the same one payloads use.
